drivers.name: Palm Jebel Ali roads & utilities
drivers.timing: Q4 2026 target for this infrastructure package; completion not independently confirmed
drivers.mechanism: Roads, power and telecom connections can make occupation and daily use feasible. Direct delivery catalyst for the island.
drivers.risk: Target is not a completed asset. Construction disruption, phasing and utility readiness remain material.
drivers.geometryBasis: No surveyed project geometry acquired. Area links are analytical context, not distance or catchment claims.

drivers.name: Palm Jebel Ali 544-villa delivery
drivers.timing: Q4 2028 target for Fronds A–F contract; other phases have separate dates
drivers.mechanism: AED3.5bn+ awards give a concrete delivery milestone for 544 villas, reducing some execution uncertainty.
drivers.risk: 544 villas are also added supply. Quality, actual handover and resale liquidity determine investment outcomes.
drivers.geometryBasis: No surveyed project geometry acquired. Area links are analytical context, not distance or catchment claims.

drivers.name: Al Maktoum airport expansion
drivers.timing: June 2026 update targets first phase in 2032; September CEO update says early 2030s and second runway by end 2027. These supersede the older ten-year horizon.
drivers.mechanism: Employment and travel capacity can support southern Dubai housing and hospitality demand. AED128bn programme; ultimate 260m passengers is planned capacity.
drivers.risk: Regional spillover to Palm Jebel Ali is an inference. Phasing, commute routes, aircraft noise and new housing supply matter.
drivers.geometryBasis: No surveyed project geometry acquired. Area links are analytical context, not distance or catchment claims.

drivers.name: Dubai Exhibition Centre expansion
drivers.timing: Phase 1 completed: 140,000 sqm reported April 2026. Remaining masterplan stages target 2028 and 2031.
drivers.mechanism: AED10bn expansion can support event activity, hospitality and employment in the southern growth corridor.
drivers.risk: Event-led demand can be seasonal. Later-phase targets and competing hotel/residential supply remain risks.
drivers.geometryBasis: No surveyed project geometry acquired. Area links are analytical context, not distance or catchment claims.

drivers.name: Dubai Metro Blue Line
drivers.timing: Opening target 9 September 2029; 20% complete reported May 2026
drivers.mechanism: Station access can lower commuting friction in the served eastern Dubai districts.
drivers.risk: Walking access and station entrances need verified geometry. This line is not a confirmed Palm Jebel Ali connection.
drivers.geometryBasis: No surveyed project geometry acquired. Area links are analytical context, not distance or catchment claims.

drivers.name: DIFC Zabeel District
drivers.timing: Launched January 2026; phased delivery must be checked
drivers.mechanism: Financial-sector expansion may support jobs and demand for nearby homes and offices. AED100bn figure is development value, not a house-price forecast.
drivers.risk: Large additional supply, delivery timing and affordability can offset employment demand.
drivers.geometryBasis: No surveyed project geometry acquired. Area links are analytical context, not distance or catchment claims.

drivers.name: Etihad Rail passenger network
drivers.timing: Abu Dhabi–Fujairah began June 2026. Dubai/Al Dhaid scheduled September 2026; Sharjah March 2027
drivers.mechanism: Inter-emirate passenger access can broaden employment and residential options near usable stations.
drivers.risk: June operation verified by operator; later scheduled openings need separate confirmation. No Palm Jebel Ali station or door-to-door catchment inferred.
drivers.geometryBasis: No surveyed project geometry acquired. Area links are analytical context, not distance or catchment claims.

drivers.name: Zayed National Museum / Saadiyat
drivers.mechanism: An operating cultural destination can strengthen tourism and the amenity appeal of Saadiyat.
drivers.risk: Existing amenity value may already be priced in. Visitor growth is not evidence of a residential uplift percentage.
drivers.geometryBasis: No surveyed project geometry acquired. Area links are analytical context, not distance or catchment claims.

drivers.name: Sharjah Airport expansion
drivers.timing: 25m annual capacity target by end 2027 in July 2025 report
drivers.mechanism: Additional airport capacity can support tourism, jobs and business access across Sharjah.
drivers.risk: Capacity is not passenger throughput. Current completion progress needs a newer verification; local noise and supply effects vary.
drivers.geometryBasis: No surveyed project geometry acquired. Area links are analytical context, not distance or catchment claims.

drivers.name: Ajman Al Talla Road & bridges
drivers.mechanism: Opened bridges and intersections improve access to named residential districts and public facilities.
drivers.risk: Travel-time improvements are authority estimates, not measured property appreciation; some benefits may already be priced in.
drivers.geometryBasis: No surveyed project geometry acquired. Area links are analytical context, not distance or catchment claims.

drivers.name: RAK wastewater treatment PPP
drivers.timing: Agreement January 2026; completion date not verified
drivers.mechanism: 60,000 cubic metres/day planned treatment capacity supports infrastructure readiness for urban growth.
drivers.risk: Service area, commissioning and tariffs need verification. No parcel-level value uplift is estimated.
drivers.geometryBasis: No surveyed project geometry acquired. Area links are analytical context, not distance or catchment claims.

drivers.name: UAQ Sustainable Blue Economy 2031
drivers.timing: 2031 strategy horizon; not a single construction handover
drivers.mechanism: Tourism, environmental protection and investment guidelines may influence long-term coastal development quality.
drivers.risk: Policy is not a completed project. Conservation restrictions can constrain developable supply and permitted uses.
drivers.geometryBasis: No surveyed project geometry acquired. Area links are analytical context, not distance or catchment claims.

drivers.name: Fujairah Al Rugaylat & Dibba ports
drivers.timing: 50-year concession signed July 2026; build-out date not verified
drivers.mechanism: Port development may support logistics investment and employment in Fujairah.
drivers.risk: Demand spillover is analytical; industrial traffic, location and future housing supply can offset benefits.
drivers.geometryBasis: No surveyed project geometry acquired. Area links are analytical context, not distance or catchment claims.

palmJebelAli.name: Palm Jebel Ali
palmJebelAli.assessment: Compelling long-term thesis; magnitude and timing of appreciation remain unproven
palmJebelAli.nearTerm: 1–3 years: execution, resale liquidity, financing and market-cycle risk dominate; villa contract target extends into 2028.
palmJebelAli.longTerm: 5–10 years: delivered waterfront amenities and southern Dubai employment/connectivity could support demand; entry price and new supply determine capture.
upside: Contract-backed road, utility and villa delivery
Regional airport and exhibition-led employment demand
risks: Large phased supply and competition from other waterfront communities
Delays, construction disruption and cash tied up before occupation
Already-priced-in catalysts, fees and resale liquidity

demandEvidence.limitation: Count in a luxury threshold cohort; not repeat-sales appreciation, occupancy or evidence of every villa phase.

localPriceEvidence.limitation: Existing derived research snapshot, not independently reconciled government export. Source classifies this series as apartments; do not use as villa evidence. Latest quarter has one sale and fails the map sample gate.

publishedOutlooks.summary: Consultancy reports mainstream softening and early signs of prime weakness amid regional uncertainty. This does not establish a Palm Jebel Ali decline or an updated numerical forecast.

sensitivity.limitation: Illustrative inputs, not estimated probabilities or a forecast. Nominal capital value only; excludes rents, financing, fees, inflation and taxes. Catalysts do not mechanically add percentage points.
